description: Returns the string substring of value beginning at zero-based position integer startIndex and ending at the position before integer endIndex. Specify -1 or omit endIndex to return through the end of value. The result is always string (a slice of anyURI is not an anyURI).

errorsThrown.reason: startIndex or endIndex is out of range

returns.description: Substring as string (not re-typed as the input data type).
